Sending “The Truck” to Creeley for the Black Mountain Review

Olson suggests sending the story to Creeley, back in Majorca since August 1954 (Rumaker has been corresponding with him since). Rumaker sends it airmail in October and waits impatiently; the magazine is also meant to offer an alternative to the limited criticism of Cid Corman's Origin and to attract students.
